nodes.description: T cells respond poorly to mitogens and antigens with reduced IFN-gamma and IL-2; CTLA4+FOXP3+ regulatory T cells are reduced; NK cells show reduced NKp46, NKG2D and CD69, impaired IFN-gamma production by CD56bright cells and paradoxically increased steady-state pS6, so that the effect of the variant on mTORC1 differs between T and NK cells.
